Root Cause Analysis — 6 issues
Ad Alignment → ATC Drop-off Addressed 3.5
ATC at 11.98% is decent but ROAS at 67.0 suggests post-ATC drop-off is the real issue. Copy is feature-list style ('Gluten Free, GMO Free') rather than benefit-driven. No risk reversal (guarantee), no scarcity, no clear 'why now'.
Add immediately below Add to Cart button: '30-Day Hairfall Guarantee — See less hair on your comb in 30 days or full refund. No questions asked.' + 'Ships within 24 hours' + '47,000+ men already seeing thicker hair'. This converts ad-driven intent into purchase confidence.
Persona × Narrative → Hero / Banner 3.5
The headline 'Biotin Hair Gummies (30N)' is purely product-descriptive and fails to address the Early-Stage Hairfall persona's #1 concern: visible hairfall panic (comb, pillow, shower drain).
Replace headline with: 'Comb pe baal, pillow pe baal? Andar se rok do.' Subhead: 'Biotin + Zinc + 6 Vitamins — what your hair is actually starving for.' This mirrors their internal panic and immediately positions the product as the answer they've been missing.
Persona × Narrative → Carousel Flow 3.0
Carousel slides are labeled generically as 'Image 1', 'Image 2', 'live_3' through 'live_9' — no discernible narrative arc. Current structure lacks the 'wrong-fix trap' callout (home remedies, oils, shampoos) and the 'hidden cause' revelation (nutrition gap).
Restructure carousel to 6-slide narrative: (1) 'Hairfall on comb, pillow, shower drain? You're not imagining it.' (2) 'Tried oils? Shampoos? Home remedies? Still falling?' (3) 'Here's what no one told you: Your diet is starving your hair follicles.' (4) 'Biotin + Zinc + Vitamins A,C,E — the nutrition your hair actually needs.' (5) Real before/after at 30 days (6) Real before/after at 90 days with '90-day transformation' label.
Persona × Narrative → CTA Language 3.5
CTAs are generic 'Add To Cart' and 'Buy Now'. The configured emotional arc should leave the persona in a state of 'finally found the real solution' urgency.
Replace primary CTA with: 'Start Stopping Hairfall Today' (action-oriented, immediate). Secondary CTA: 'Rok lo abhi — before it gets worse' (Hindi emotional trigger + fear of inaction). Test both against control for 2 weeks.
Reviews → Freshness 3.5
All 4 reviews are from April 2026, approximately 137-144 days old. No reviews from the last 3 months (May-August 2026). Review activity stopped abruptly in mid-April.
Implement 14-day post-delivery email: 'Seeing less hair on your comb yet? Tell us (and others) — Leave a quick review.' Follow up at 30 days with 'You've completed 1 bottle — how's the hairfall?' Incentivize with 10% off next order for photo reviews. Target: 4+ new reviews per month.
Reviews → Negative Handling 2.0
Zero negative reviews exist to evaluate handling. No brand responses or engagement visible on any review. The absence of any criticism appears curated.
Respond to ALL existing reviews within 48 hours: 'Thanks Vipul! Glad to hear the results at 90 days. Keep it going!' When negative reviews appear (and they will), respond within 24 hours with: acknowledgment + specific solution + offer to make it right. Example: 'Sorry to hear that, Rahul. Some see results by day 30, others by day 60 — DM us and we'll extend your supply at no cost.'

Visual Scores — click to expand
Human Presence
7.0/10
Human figures are present in multiple images. Image 4 shows four young Indian men demonstrating hair loss stages (Stage 1-4), which is relevant to the target persona. Images 22-23 show a young Indian male model (late 20s/early 30s) with full, healthy hair eating the gummy and holding the product with a confident smile. However, the model appears slightly older than the core 18-26 persona and projects success rather than the anxiety/frustration of early-stage hairfall. No emotional journey from panic to relief is shown.
Add imagery of a younger male (20-24) showing the emotional arc - worried expression checking his comb/pillow, then transitioning to confident after using product. Include relatable moments like checking hair in bathroom mirror or running hands through hair with concern.
Proof Prominence
7.5/10
Image 5 prominently displays clinical trial data with 'Clinical trial registry India Certificate' header and three bold statistics: '90% Men experienced a 53% reduction in hair thinning' (wash test), '90% Men experienced a 50% reduction' (comb test), '80% Men reported their hair felt more voluminous'. The percentages are in large bold text on the left side. CTRI logo with QR code appears at bottom. However, these proof points appear only in one carousel image, not reinforced throughout the PDP.
Make the 90%/53% statistic more visually dominant by using a contrasting highlight color (yellow or white box). Repeat key proof stats as badges or callouts in the hero image and in ingredient slides. Add the CTRI certification badge to multiple images for credibility reinforcement.
Ingredient Imagery
7.0/10
Image 2 shows 'Clinically Proven Ingredients' with Biotin, Zinc, and Vitamin A,C,E listed with text descriptions. Surrounding the product are visual representations of ingredients - strawberries, almonds, seeds/grains - creating a natural, premium aesthetic. Images 14-16 show detailed 3D cross-section renderings of hair follicles and scalp at cellular level, appearing scientific and premium. However, the actual key ingredients (Biotin, Zinc, specific vitamins) are not shown in their raw/natural form.
Add close-up imagery of ingredient sources - foods rich in Biotin (eggs, nuts), Zinc (pumpkin seeds), and vitamins in visually appealing arrangements. Create an infographic showing each ingredient with its corresponding benefit using icons and brief text for quick scanning.
Before / After
5.5/10
Image 4 shows four men at different hair loss stages (Stage 1-4) to help users self-identify, but this is a stage identification tool rather than a transformation visual. Images 14-16 show scientific 3D renders of hair follicles - healthy, dense, and with nutrient delivery - but these are abstract illustrations, not real before/after user photos. No actual user transformation photos showing reduced hairfall or improved hair density over 90 days are present.
Add real user before/after photos showing the same person at Day 1 vs Day 90, photographed from the same angle with consistent lighting. Focus on visible improvements: fewer hairs on comb, denser hairline, healthier scalp. Include user testimonial alongside the visual for authenticity.
Lifestyle Shots
5.0/10
Images 28-31 show user-generated content with product in real environments - airport/cafe setting, home desk with monitor, personal workspace with cap and alarm clock. These feel authentic but lack aspirational quality. Images 22-23 show model in studio setting with plain blue background, which is clean but not lifestyle-oriented. No images show the target persona in his actual life context - college, office, gym, social situations.
Create lifestyle imagery showing young men (18-26) in relatable scenarios: getting ready for work/college, at a morning routine, casually taking gummy during breakfast, confidently in social settings. Show the product integrated into a young professional's or student's daily routine rather than isolated product shots.
Visual Hierarchy & Brand
7.5/10
Consistent navy blue and white color palette throughout all images maintains strong brand identity. 'Man Matters' logo appears prominently on product packaging visible in multiple images. Hero images (1-3) effectively lead with product name 'Hair Gummies' and key benefit 'Reduce hair fall in 90 days'. Images 17-21 use consistent iconography for claims (No Chemicals, Cruelty Free, Gluten Free, etc.). However, the most important emotional hook ('your nutrition gap is the real cause') doesn't appear prominently in early carousel slides.
Restructure visual hierarchy in hero images to lead with the persona's pain point ('Tried everything but hair still falling?') before showing product. Use larger typography for the '90 days' promise. Add visual emphasis (glow, highlight, arrow) to direct eye flow from problem statement to solution.

Body Copy (10 blocks)
Enriched With Zinc, Biotin & Multivitamins For Hair
We recommend you stick to having no more than one gummy a day.
Hair thinning usually happens when hair follicles become miniaturised over time because of sensitivity to DHT - a by product of testosterone. Adequate Zinc consumption helps keep DHT in check, helping with this. The nutrients in them, like biotin, also help strengthen weak hair.
While these gummies might not directly help with hair growth, they do help nourish your scalp and strength your hair follicles.
In order to get positive results when supplementing with vitamins like Biotin, consistency is key. These delicious gummies are super easy to consume, helping you stay on track with your supplementation, every day. It's also fortified with additional helpful ingredients like Zinc and Vitamins A, C and E, for added benefits.
It would be best if you took it at the same time daily to make sure it's a habit and you're consistently taking one gummy a day. For example, as a dessert after your lunch daily.
Naturally gluten-free.
These gummies are made from plant-based ingredients and plant-based ingredients do not have a uniform colour. The colour may range from greenish to brownish based on natural raw material variations. We do not use artificial colours to maintain the visual look of the gummies. The colour does not impact the product's efficacy, quality, shelf life, or taste.
Improving hair texture is a long process. We would recommend having these gummies for at least 3-4 months to see visible results.

Hair thinning usually happens when hair follicles become miniaturised over time because of sensitivity to DHT - a by product of testosterone. Adequate Zinc consumption helps keep DHT in check, helping with this. The nutrients in them, like biotin, also help strengthen weak hair.

Reviews → Negative Handling 1.0

Reviews → Freshness 3.0
All 4 reviews are from January 2026, making them 212-229 days old (7+ months). There are no reviews from the last 6 months.
Launch a 2-week post-purchase email campaign targeting buyers from the last 90 days with incentive (₹50 off next order) for photo reviews. Add in-app prompt at Day 45 and Day 90 post-purchase. Target: 10+ fresh reviews within 30 days, at least 3 with progress photos.
Visual Design → Before / After 3.5
The 'Stage 1-4' classification slide shows different people at different stages of hairfall, but this is NOT a transformation visual — it merely classifies severity.
Create a dedicated Slide 3 showing SAME person transformation: Day 1 (visible scalp, 50+ strands on comb) vs Day 90 (denser hairline, <15 strands on comb). Hair Vitamins with Zinc & Biotin for Hair
Hairfall noticed on comb, pillow, and hands after shower. Just use Man Matters Hair Gummies (30 N): Contains Biotin, Zinc, and Vitamins A, C & E which strengthen hair roots from within by nourishing follicles with essential nutrients.
Use it consistently for 90 days to see visible reduction in hairfall.
Just take 1 gummy a day after any meal.
93% men saw reduced hairfall in 90 days.
Complete your hair nutrition. Now.
Biotin is known to improve keratin structure
Zinc has hair strengthening properties
Vitamin A is known to boost hair health, adding moisture to the scalp
One of the reasons for hair thinning is free radical damage
+ 19 more blocks
Contains Permitted Natural Flavour(s).
One gummy per day
Note: There is no specific time for having these hair gummies. We recommend you treat it as your dessert after lunch or fix a particular time to have these biotin gummies.
Talking about personal health is hard. Often embarrassing. We get that. So we took 'matters' into our own hands; and created a place for all matters of man. Hair, skin, weight, sleep, performance and much more. We get you, and we get what matters to you.
With so many unreliable sources and searches, it's hard to decide whom to trust. Our solutions are trusted by experts, and are backed by science. We believe that wellness has a science behind it and we want to make it more accessible.
Wellness is an actively pursued goal of being in a state of good health. We believe that compliance and discipline matter if you want to move towards wellbeing, and we get that it's not easy. We are here to handhold you and help you on this journey.
These hair gummies are the first step towards having nourished hair. If you're looking to improve your hair health, you should explore shampoos, serums and other products targeted to give you a nourished mane.
Though these hair vitamins are meant to fill nutritional gaps it won't replace the need for nourished food. Ensure you have good dietary foods such as eggs, spinach and other green leafy vegetables to help boost your hair health.
Plastic combs cause micro-tears in your scalp, weakening your follicles. A wooden comb evenly distributes sebum more evenly throughout the mane, making your hair resilient against everyday challenges.
All good things take time, so does improving hair health. Don't expect an immediate improvement in your hair quality.
Each person is different, and the way our solution works on everyone is different.
Hair improvement is a gradual process. While these biotin hair gummies would help in curbing hair thinning, it won't completely bring it to a stop. You still have to follow good hair hygiene and have a proper diet.
Hair thinning usually happens when hair follicles become miniaturised over time because of sensitivity to DHT - a by product of testosterone. Adequate Zinc consumption helps keep DHT in check, helping with this. The nutrients in them, like biotin, also help strengthen weak hair.
While these gummies might not directly help with hair growth, they do help nourish your scalp and strength your hair follicles.
In order to get positive results when supplementing with vitamins like Biotin, consistency is key. These delicious gummies are super easy to consume, helping you stay on track with your supplementation, every day. It's also fortified with additional helpful ingredients like Zinc and Vitamins A, C and E, for added benefits.
Improving hair texture is a long process. We would recommend having these gummies for at least 3-4 months to see visible results.
List of Ingredients: Biotin, Vitamin A, Zinc, Vitamin C, Vitamin E
These gummies are made from plant-based ingredients and plant-based ingredients do not have a uniform colour.
Yes, naturally gluten-free.
